findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_appeal_rights · Private data: get_appeal_rights, get_appeal_deadlines, draft_appeal_letter · Public sink: draft_appeal_letter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_appeal_rights · Private data: get_appeal_rights, get_appeal_deadlines, draft_appeal_letter · Public sink: draft_appeal_letter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
